title: Provo Canyon School
excerpt: A locked residential treatment program in Utah County founded in 1971 and owned by Universal Health Services since 2000. Utah revoked both campus licenses in July 2026 after decades of abuse allegations; operations are suspended while the school's appeal is pending.
